description: For one of the organization's connected websites, per day: clicks, impressions and average position from Google Search Console, and visits, visits from search and engaged visits from Google Analytics. Search Console leaves out rare searches, so totals are lower than in Search Console. At most 366 days. A website that is not this organization's, not verified or not connected to Google answers not found. It changes nothing.

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the 28 days ending on the latest day with data.

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the 28 days ending on the latest day with data.

name: webops_daily
title: Daily search and visit totals
